Sandtopia Pilgrimage

The Sandtopia Pilgrimage is about to begin! Go for the champion with your guild members!

Activity TypeGuildWarPhases3Duration6 or 7 days

Across all phases

GameplayEvent Rules30 sections
Event Overview

◆ The Sandtopia Pilgrimage event consists of three phases: preparation, preliminary, and final match.

Preparation

◆ During the preparation phase, guilds can obtain materials by exploring oases and use them to strengthen their guild sandships for the upcoming preliminary and final match. The top {preliminaryNum} guilds in the preparation phase will qualify to participate in the preliminary.

Preliminary

◆ The leaders of each guild must choose a Torch to compete for before the preliminary begins. Once the preliminary starts, the guild sandships will begin moving towards the selected Torch. Transcenders can delay the progress of other guilds by attacking or otherwise hindering them in order to reach the Torch first.

◆ There are a total of {destNum} Torches. The first {destNum} guilds that reach each Torch will enter the final match.

Final Match

◆ The rules of the final match are the same as those of the preliminary, except that the goal of the participating guilds is to be the first to deliver the Torch to the Old Land of Sand. The guild that arrives there first will be declared the winner of this Sandtopia Pilgrimage.

◆ Transcenders can congratulate the winning guild after the final match to receive a thank-you gift.

Rankings

◆ The Sandtopia Pilgrimage event has three rankings: (1) the Guild Preparation Ranking, which is based on the total Preparation Score during the preparation phase; (2) the Guild Race Ranking, which is based on the performance of the guilds during the preliminary and final match; (3) the Personal Glory Ranking, which is based on the total Glory obtained by each Transcender during the event.

Exploration

◆ Transcenders can use compass to explore. Compasses regenerate over time: 1 compass every 30 minutes. No regeneration upon reaching limit. Transcenders can also spend crystals to purchase compasses during the event.

◆ Each time a Transcender explores, a random Material Production Site will be discovered. There is a limit to the number of uncollected Material Production Sites on the list. When the discovery limit is reached, finding a new site will replace the previously discovered site of the lowest quality.

Material Collection

◆ Transcenders can collect materials from production sites by dispatching their Fellows to a site. There is no limit to the number of fellows that can be dispatched to a production site each time, but their Power must meet the collection requirements of the site. Fellows can only be dispatched to collect materials from a single production site at a time.

◆ After a certain period of time, the dispatched Fellows will finish collecting the materials at a production site. Transcenders can use Hourglasses to accelerate the collection process.

Guild Sandship

◆ The materials collected by Transcenders can be used to enhance the guild sandship to gain more advantages during the preliminary and final match.

◆ There are three facilities on the guild sandship that can be enhanced: the Phaser Cannon, which provides additional attack power; the Hero Statue, which provides a defense bonus; and the Beverage Station, which restores attack chances.

◆ The Phaser Cannon and Beverage Station can only be enhanced using materials collected from exploration, while the Hero Statue can be enhanced by gold and crystals in addition to using materials.

◆ Each time materials are used on enhancing, the Preparation Score of the guild sandship will be increased, and the Transcender that initiated the upgrade will gain a corresponding amount of Preparation Glory and Preparation Pack. Enhancing with crystals can increase the Preparation Score of the sandship but will not award Preparation Glory and Preparation Pack.

◆ After a facility is upgraded, its effect will be enhanced and each guild member will receive a Guild Pack.

◆ When the Preparation Score of the guild sandship reaches a certain value, the Preparation Stage will be increased, providing each guild member with a reward.

The End of the Preparation Phase

◆ When the preparation phase ends, all unfinished material collections will end immediately without rewarding materials.

◆ Facilities of guild sandship cannot be upgraded after the preparation phase has ended.

Guild Preparation Rankings

◆ Guilds will be ranked according to the total Preparation Score they accumulated during the preparation phase. After preparation has concluded, players will receive ranking rewards based on the ranking of their guild.

Qualification

◆ During the preparation phase, guilds ranked in the top {preliminaryNum} in terms of the Preparation Score will qualify for the preliminary.

◆ Guilds that do not qualify for the preliminary can spectate the race but cannot participate.

Setting a Torch Target

◆ The leaders of guilds that qualify for the preliminary must choose one of {destNum} Torches as the target for their guild sandship before the start of the preliminary. During the preliminary, all the guild sandships that chose the same Torch will compete for a single spot in the final match.

◆ Before the start of the preliminary, Guild Leaders can freely change their Torches.

◆ If the Guild Leader does not specify a Torch for their guild sandship before the start of the preliminary, the system will randomly assign them a Torch as their target.

Setting Teams

◆ Members of qualifying guilds need to select 8 Fellows to join the Attack Team and 8 Fellows to join the Defense Team before the start of the preliminary.

◆ During the preliminary and final match, only Fellows in the Attack Team can actively attack other guilds.

◆ During the preliminary and final match, all members of the guild's Defense Team will be responsible for defending the guild sandship. The Power of the Defense Team will be converted directly to the HP of the guild sandship. The guild sandship's Hero Statue will also provide an additional bonus to the guild sandship’s HP.

◆ If a Transcender has not set an Attack/Defense Team before the preliminary begins, or if their teams are incomplete, the system will automatically complete the teams at the start of the preliminary.

Objective

◆ During the preliminary, the first {destNum} guilds to reach each Torch will enter the final match.

Advancing the Sandships

◆ After the preliminary begins, the sandships of each guild will begin advancing towards their designated Torch at a speed of {speed} m/sec. When a guild sandship is attacked by another guild sandship, it will lose HP and its speed will decrease. For example, a sandship with 80% remaining HP will move at 80% of its initial speed.

Combat

◆ Transcenders can send Fellows from the Attack Team to attack other guild sandships. When attacking, the Fellows will deal damage equal to their Power to the Defensive Fellows on the opposing guild sandship. At the same time, the Phaser Cannon will assist in the attack to deal additional damage.

◆ Each attack will earn Race Glory. If an attack defeats the opposing Defensive Fellows, additional Race Glory and item rewards will be obtained. When the HP of a guild sandship is reduced to 0, each member of the guild will receive a Guild Pack. Only the members of the first guild to reduce the HP of the opponent's sandship to 0 can receive the Guild Pack.

◆ Each attack will consume one of the Attacking Fellow’s attack chances. Each Fellow in the Attack Team has one initial attack chance during each match, which can be restored using Chilled Watermelon or Watermelon Soda. When using the same type of item to restore a Fellow’s attack attempts multiple times, the number of items required will be increased. Chilled Watermelon and Watermelon Soda each can be used to restore up to 5 attack chances.

◆ During the preliminary and final match, the Beverage Station on the guild sandship will produce one Chilled Watermelon every few minutes. Chilled Watermelon items will be cleared after the preliminary or final match has ended.

◆ Attacks cannot be launched against sandships that have already reached a Torch or sandships that have stopped moving (HP is 0).

Prism Attacks

◆ Transcenders can use Prism items to attack other guild sandships. Using Prism to attack will earn Race Glory. A Guild Pack will be earned if the HP of the opposing sandship is successfully defeated. Only the members of the first guild to reduce the HP of the opponent's sandship to 0 can receive the Guild Pack.

◆ Some Prism items can be obtained during the preparation phase.

Healing Fellows

◆ The defeated Defensive Fellows will recover automatically. Starting from first defeated Defensive Fellow, the recovery will occur every 3 minutes. The first defeated fellow will begin recovering first. Each recovery can restore 1 fellow's up to 0.5% of the guild sandship's total HP.

◆ Transcenders can use a Medical Kit to fully recover 1 defeated Defensive Fellow. The HP of the recovered Fellow will be restored to 100%. Each Fellow can only be healed once. Only one's own Defensive Fellows can be healed.

Changing Targets

◆ During the preliminary, Guild Leaders can freely change their guild sandship’s Torches.

◆ When changing Torches, the distance between the guild sandship and the new Torch will be increased by {dist} meters. After each changing, there is a 1-hour cooldown period before changing to another torch.

Reaching the Target

◆ After the guild reaches a Torch, each guild member will receive a Guild Pack. The guild that reaches the Torch first will qualify for the final match.

◆ If no guild reaches one of the Torches at the end of the preliminary, the guild closest to the Torch will qualify.

Guild Race Rankings

◆ After the end of the preliminary, the guilds that did not qualify for the final match will be ranked from 9th to 64th. Guilds that reached their Torches will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach their Torches will be ranked in order of their distance to the Torch from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Torches at the same or their distances to the Torches are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

Qualification

◆ During the preliminary, the first {destNum} guilds to reach each Torch will enter the final match.

◆ If no guild reaches one of the Torches at the end of the preliminary, the guild closest to the Torch will qualify.

◆ Guilds that do not qualify for the final match can spectate the race but cannot participate.

Adjusting Teams

◆ Guild members who qualify for the final match can readjust their Attack and Defense Teams before the start of the final match.

Objective

◆ In the final match, the guild that reaches the Old Land of Sand first will be declared the winner of this Sandtopia Pilgrimage.

Other Actions during the Final Match

◆ In the final match, Transcenders can send Fellows from their Attack Team to actively attack other guild sandships, use Prism items to deal damage to opponent sandships, and heal defeated Defensive Fellows. The basic rules are the same as in the preliminary. The healing limit and attack chances of a Fellow will be reset before the final match begins.

Reaching the Target

◆ After a guild reaches the Old Land of Sand, each member of the guild will receive a Guild Pack. The guild that reaches there first will be declared the winner of Sandtopia Pilgrimage.

◆ If no guild reaches the ancient ruins at the end of the final, the guild closest to the Old Land of Sand will be declared the winner.

Guild Race Rankings

◆ After the end of the final match, the participating guilds will be ranked from 1st to 8th. Guilds that reached the Old Land of Sand will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach the ruins will be ranked in order of their distance to the Old Land of Sand from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Old Land of Sand at the same or their distances to the Old Land of Sand are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

◆ After the end of the preliminary and the final match, all participating guild members will receive ranking rewards based on the results of the race.

◆ Within the guild that won the event, the member with the highest Glory other than the Guild Leader will be selected as the MVP of this Sandtopia Pilgrimage.

After the Final Match

◆ After the final match, each Transcender can go to the winning guild to celebrate and receive a reward.

Glory rewards

◆ Transcenders in Sandtopia Pilgrimage can earn Preparation Glory by enhancing sandships. Attacking opponents and using Prism Items during the Preliminaries and the Finals can earn Race Glory. Earning the required amount of Glory during the event can claim the corresponding Glory rewards.

◆ After the event ends, all Glory earned by Transcenders will be cleared, and unclaimed Glory Rewards will be sent to players in the mail.

The Fellow Leon

◆ Players can obtain Leon Fragments through Glory Rewards and the Guild Race Ranking. Collecting enough fragments will allow Transcenders to invite Leon to join them as a Fellow. Leon Fragments will be kept after each event.

G
Guild Ranking

◆ Guilds will be ranked according to the total Preparation Score they accumulated during the preparation phase. After preparation has concluded, players will receive ranking rewards based on the ranking of their guild.

◆ After the end of the preliminary, the guilds that did not qualify for the final match will be ranked from 9th to 64th. Guilds that reached their Torches will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach their Torches will be ranked in order of their distance to the Torch from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Torches at the same or their distances to the Torches are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

◆ After the end of the final match, the participating guilds will be ranked from 1st to 8th. Guilds that reached the Old Land of Sand will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach the ruins will be ranked in order of their distance to the Old Land of Sand from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Old Land of Sand at the same or their distances to the Old Land of Sand are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

◆ After the end of the preliminary and the final match, all participating guild members will receive ranking rewards based on the results of the race.

◆ Within the guild that won the event, the member with the highest Glory other than the Guild Leader will be selected as the MVP of this Sandtopia Pilgrimage.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

◆ The Sandtopia Pilgrimage event has three rankings: (1) the Guild Preparation Ranking, which is based on the total Preparation Score during the preparation phase; (2) the Guild Race Ranking, which is based on the performance of the guilds during the preliminary and final match; (3) the Personal Glory Ranking, which is based on the total Glory obtained by each Transcender during the event.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

G
Guild Ranking

◆ Guilds will be ranked according to the total Preparation Score they accumulated during the preparation phase. After preparation has concluded, players will receive ranking rewards based on the ranking of their guild.

◆ After the end of the preliminary, the guilds that did not qualify for the final match will be ranked from 9th to 64th. Guilds that reached their Torches will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach their Torches will be ranked in order of their distance to the Torch from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Torches at the same or their distances to the Torches are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

◆ After the end of the final match, the participating guilds will be ranked from 1st to 8th. Guilds that reached the Old Land of Sand will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach the ruins will be ranked in order of their distance to the Old Land of Sand from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Old Land of Sand at the same or their distances to the Old Land of Sand are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

◆ After the end of the preliminary and the final match, all participating guild members will receive ranking rewards based on the results of the race.

◆ Within the guild that won the event, the member with the highest Glory other than the Guild Leader will be selected as the MVP of this Sandtopia Pilgrimage.

CompetitionRankings2 ranking types

◆ The Sandtopia Pilgrimage event has three rankings: (1) the Guild Preparation Ranking, which is based on the total Preparation Score during the preparation phase; (2) the Guild Race Ranking, which is based on the performance of the guilds during the preliminary and final match; (3) the Personal Glory Ranking, which is based on the total Glory obtained by each Transcender during the event.

Reward Set selection is server/runtime dependent; all statically configured sets are shown.

G
Guild Ranking

◆ Guilds will be ranked according to the total Preparation Score they accumulated during the preparation phase. After preparation has concluded, players will receive ranking rewards based on the ranking of their guild.

◆ After the end of the preliminary, the guilds that did not qualify for the final match will be ranked from 9th to 64th. Guilds that reached their Torches will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach their Torches will be ranked in order of their distance to the Torch from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Torches at the same or their distances to the Torches are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

◆ After the end of the final match, the participating guilds will be ranked from 1st to 8th. Guilds that reached the Old Land of Sand will be ranked according to the order of their arrival, while guilds that did not reach the ruins will be ranked in order of their distance to the Old Land of Sand from nearest to farthest. If the guilds reach the Old Land of Sand at the same or their distances to the Old Land of Sand are the same, they will be ranked based on their total Guild Preparation Score.

◆ After the end of the preliminary and the final match, all participating guild members will receive ranking rewards based on the results of the race.

◆ Within the guild that won the event, the member with the highest Glory other than the Guild Leader will be selected as the MVP of this Sandtopia Pilgrimage.
